description: Report that a call SUCCEEDED. Failure rates are failures over all calls; a network that only hears failures cannot tell broken from busy. No error data -- service, operation, version, latency.

operation.description: The tool or endpoint as the server names it, e.g. 'create_issue', not 'mcp__github__create_issue'.

reporter_id.description: Optional stable agent id; hashed, never stored raw.

schema_hash.description: Short hash of the tool schema used.

service.description: The MCP server's own name (serverInfo.name) or the API host, e.g. 'api.github.com'. Not your client's local alias.

name: report_tool_success
title: Report a successful tool call to the network
